usedFor: Blog2Social publishes link, image or video posts to a connected account with “Create Post”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Create Post” in Blog2Social
bestTemplate.why: A message in a channel can start a post on a connected social account.

watchOut: “Create Post” needs a connected social account, which “Connect Social Account” links with an authorization link.
